verdict.rationale: The only design-tool evidence is the Figma integration, and it works in the opposite direction: it embeds Figma prototypes inside ClickUp Tasks, Docs and Chat. Nothing shows status being updated from within Figma. A designer could get there only through custom work, using the Public API (create/update tasks), n8n or the MCP server. Missing for 10: a native design-tool plugin for updating task status, documentation of a two-way Figma sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
